findings.finding: FY2025 operating income in the prefetch is wrong: pf_operating_income_fy2025 = -425,313k ('derived: pretax_income + interest_expense', facts._ebit_proxy) does not tie to the 10-K; statement of operations: total revenues 70,918k - total operating expenses 358,631k = -287,713k (reading/release_2026-03-02__asts-ex99_1.txt lines ~397-459 and the 10-K). Same defect in pf_operating_income_fy2024 (-506,302k vs -242,762k) and pf_operating_income_q_2026_06_30 (-275,206k vs -297,577k = 31,520k - 329,097k). The lane facts nm_operating_income_fy2025/fy2024/q_2026_06_30 carry the right values, so the pack holds two conflicting values for the same metric and period; understand/auto.json already uses the wrong one (FY2025 operating margin -5.997 instead of about -4.06) and prefetch/forensic.json ROIC (-26.6%) is built on it (about -10% with the filing value).
findings.where: gather/_prefetch.json facts pf_operating_income_fy2025, pf_operating_income_fy2024, pf_operating_income_q_2026_06_30 (vs gather/numbers.json nm_operating_income_*); understand/auto.json history; prefetch/forensic.json roic_last
findings.fix: Drop or supersede the three pf_operating_income_* facts so only nm_operating_income_* reach the pack; rerun ticker-value so history margins, forensic ROIC and any base-year margin use -287.7M (FY2025), -242.8M (FY2024), -297.6M (Q2 2026, incl. the 125.9M BB7 involuntary-conversion loss, a one-off).

findings.finding: pf_short_term_investments_fy2025 = 2,000,000k is a mis-mapped companyfacts tag: neither the 10-K (2025-12-31) nor the 10-Q (2026-06-30) balance sheet has a short-term investments line (cash and cash equivalents 2,335,683k / 2,288,253k only; restricted cash 443.4M / 434.6M non-current is not spendable). If it reaches the capital bridge it adds 2.0B of phantom liquidity (about 5 USD per economic unit).
findings.where: gather/_prefetch.json fact pf_short_term_investments_fy2025 (numbers lane note 'BALANCE SHEET CHECK' / 'CASH RECONCILIATION')
findings.fix: Remove the fact from the pack (or set it to 0 with the 10-K as source); confirm value.json/casefile cash = 2,288.3M spendable at 2026-06-30 with restricted cash separate.

findings.finding: Operating-cost and capex guidance for the year in progress rests only on third-party search excerpts, not issuer documents: dc_g_adjopex_q3_2026 (105-115M), dc_g_adjopex_avg_fy2026 (~100M/quarter), dc_g_adjopex_avg_fy2026_orig (70-80M) and dc_g_capex_q3_2026 (350-425M) cite dc_tr_q2_2026 / dc_tr_q4_2025 (search_excerpt transcriptions on Tiger Brokers and Webull); the Q2 2026 capex and adjusted-opex track rows cite dc_mb_q1_2026, a MarketBeat automated summary (kind press). None of these figures appears in the saved issuer releases (reading/release_2026-08-10__*, release_2026-05-11__*).
findings.where: gather/documents.json guidance dc_g_adjopex_q3_2026, dc_g_adjopex_avg_fy2026, dc_g_adjopex_avg_fy2026_orig, dc_g_capex_q3_2026; guidance_track rows Q2 2026 adjusted_opex_ex_cost_of_revenue and Q2 2026 capex (source dc_mb_q1_2026)
findings.fix: Either cite the issuer's own call transcript/webcast (or an issuer 8-K) or keep these as attributed, unverified call statements: say so next to any driver that uses them and do not treat the MarketBeat summary as guidance.

findings.finding: The revenue guidance track record is double-counted: the same H2 2025 row (guided mid 62.5M, actual 69.0M) is entered in both fragments, so ticker-check reports n=2, beats=2 when there is one guided period (ratio 1.104 is right; the lane's own note says n=1).
findings.where: gather/documents.json guidance_track H2 2025 revenue and gather/numbers.json guidance_track H2 2025 revenue
findings.fix: Keep one H2 2025 row (numbers.json, actual 69,044k) and delete the duplicate in documents.json; the track record must read n=1, 1 beat, too few for a pattern.

findings.finding: Transcript sources are syndicated copies registered as independent originals: dc_tr_q4_2025 is 'The Motley Fool (republished on Webull)' and dc_tr_q2_2026 a TTM Stock News transcription on Tiger Brokers, both with syndicated_from null and independent true; they are also copies of the issuer's own call (not independent evidence).
findings.fix: Set syndicated_from (The Motley Fool / TTM Stock News, original: AST SpaceMobile earnings call) and independent false.

findings.finding: Citation points to the wrong exhibit or a document that does not contain the figure: dc_g_rev_h2_2025 (50-75M) cites pf_rel_20250811_1, but the saved 2025-08-11 release text has no H2 2025 revenue guidance (the reiteration is in pf_rel_20251110_2); dc_g_sats_end2026_mar (45-60 satellites by end 2026) cites pf_rel_20260302_1, but the text is in pf_rel_20260302_2.
findings.where: gather/documents.json guidance dc_g_rev_h2_2025, dc_g_sats_end2026_mar; numbers.json guidance_track H2 2025 source_ids
findings.fix: Add pf_rel_20251110_2 to dc_g_rev_h2_2025 and the H2 2025 track row; change dc_g_sats_end2026_mar to pf_rel_20260302_2.

findings.finding: H1 2026 revenue rounded wrong: dc_rev_h1_2026 = 46.2M, the 10-Q/release show 46,255k (46.3M; = 14,735k + 31,520k).

Basis mismatch in the opex track: the Q1 2026 row uses the FY2026 average-per-quarter range (70-80M, dc_g_adjopex_avg_fy2026_orig) as a Q1 guided midpoint (75M) against the Q1 actual 79.8M (adjusted opex excluding adjusted cost of revenue, release 2026-05-11, verified).
findings.fix: Label it as an annual-average guide compared with one quarter, or drop it from the track record.
